title: Shared-source same_session evaluation refusal leaves callers stuck: saved preference refuses with no fallback, remedy text unusable
outcome: A caller whose same_session selection comes only from a saved preference gets another admitted mode, and a pin or same-session-only policy gets a refusal with a remedy it can actually follow.
acceptance: Real-request tests cover the preference route reselecting an admitted mode with one capture, a pinned same_session refused despite an admitted independent mode, a same-session-only policy refused, and an unavailable owner keeping the same_session brief; the refusal names a remedy the caller can act on and the tool description matches.
It is on master through a review pair with no Medium or higher and the normal full gate; the agreed DRAFT 1.2 refusal of new shared same_session preparation and the wire are unchanged.

completion.summary: Landed actionable same_session preference fallback with one source capture, explicit pin/policy refusal and unavailable-owner compatibility in master db52491e; real-request regressions and exact-input independent pair/full gates passed.
